## Autonomous next experiment — N0 normal evidence multiplicity

User directly authorized designing the next bounded experiment to advance the overall research goal. E1's NO_ROOT_EFFECT_GAP remains unchanged; P5 target efficacy is not reopened.

Task: keep frozen E1 PCA/SPE + causal LSTM reference, original normal calibration and mathematical score availability. Before new inference, seal/push exact raw identities for three previously unevaluated normal traces6_0_100000_42 /9_0_100000_4 /10_0_100000_13. Duplicate each calibration source1/4/16/64 times without adding unique observations. Compare same-estimator row-pooled, equal-trace and identity-deduplicated q.995 thresholds. No training, faults/recall, model/threshold/type selection or lifecycle rescue.

Acceptance: immutable source/array/checkpoint hashes; virtual replication agrees with literal duplicate quantile; balancing/dedup invariance; external normalFPR per run for both families; positive gate only>=1IQR threshold range and>=0.01 absoluteFPR spread in>=2 unseen runs per family. Otherwise preserve NO_MATERIAL_EXTERNAL_EFFECT. Generic weighted/group calibration prior art occupied; no novelty guarantee or methodGO. Record exposed E1 outcomes, prospective new tests, costs and limits. Commit/push seal before inference, then results and verification, same-Issue evidence report. This is an autonomous task record, not external peer review.
